raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Follow up on #8180: FSDP2 merged-LoRA HF export reuses the rollout generator, which casts FP32 master weights to BF16 before the HF writer applies its export dtype policy. FP16 and FP32 exports therefore lose precision and contain BF16 tensors. Preserve stored precision for the HF callback and let the existing writer apply its dtype policy; rollout retains its BF16 default.

For CPU-offloaded shards, finish host-to-device staging before the merge context can restore the pinned source storage. Otherwise, a consumer retaining the generated tensors can receive restored base weights while the asynchronous copy is still pending. The change retains per-tensor streaming and the existing merge/restore lifecycle.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Searched [LoRA dtype PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+LoRA+dtype), [LoRA offload PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+LoRA+offload), and [follow-ups to #8180](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+8180+in%3Abody). No matching fix found. #8110 changes VeOmni rollout receiver precision; #8046 changes vLLM sleep behavior. Neither fixes this generator's HF dtype or source-storage lifetime.
- [x] Title follows the module/type convention.

### Test

Real 2×RTX 3080 Ti, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130, Transformers 5.12.1, PEFT 0.20.0. Locally constructed tiny Qwen2 with nonzero LoRA; no model download.

```bash
python -m pytest tests/utils/ckpt/test_fsdp_lora_hf_export.py -q
python -m pytest tests/utils/test_fsdp_lora_merge.py -q -k 'qwen2 or collect_merged_lora_params'
python -m pytest tests/checkpoint_engine/test_fsdp_lora_only_checkpoint_on_cpu.py tests/utils/ckpt/test_lora_custom_object_save_on_cpu.py tests/workers/rollout/rollout_sglang/test_lora_merge_mode_on_cpu.py -q
pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure
```

The final patch passes all 6 regression cases across FP32/FP16/BF16 and CPU offload on/off. The same test on main fails all 4 FP32/FP16 cases on dtype and passes the 2 BF16 controls. It checks saved dtype/weights and HF reload outputs against an independent PEFT merge, tied-weight coverage, exact restoration of training parameters, and BF16 rollout behavior.

Actual FSDPEngine initialization and two training steps also pass with CPU offload on/off, with HF export/reload between the steps. The original engine continues training; HF files are checked as inference exports. A local diagnostic queues `torch.cuda._sleep(200_000_000)` before consuming the merged rollout generator: the dtype-only fix still corrupts 509/1024 q_proj elements, while the complete patch passes.

All 14 repository pre-commit hooks pass on the final patch. Adjacent LoRA GPU tests (8 passed, 4 deselected) and CPU tests (26 passed) ran on the dtype fix before the final staging adjustment; their helper/config paths were unchanged by that last adjustment. No large-model quality or throughput claim is made.

### API and Usage Example

No new configuration. Existing `hf_model` saves respect the checkpoint writer's precision policy for merged LoRA weights.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the contribution guide.
- [x] Full repository pre-commit checks passed on the current patch.
- [x] Documented the internal dtype and staging contracts in the generator.
- [x] Added GPU regression tests automatically discovered by `gpu_unit_tests.yml`.
- [ ] Request CI through the project channel after the PR is ready.
- [x] No recipe submodule change.

AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation, validation, and drafting.

+
+import copy
+import json
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model
+from safetensors.torch import load_file
+from torch.distributed.device_mesh import init_device_mesh
+from torch.distributed.fsdp import CPUOffloadPolicy, MixedPrecisionPolicy
+from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, Qwen2Config
+
+from verl.utils.checkpoint.fsdp_checkpoint_manager import FSDPCheckpointManager
+from verl.utils.device import get_device_name, get_nccl_backend, get_torch_device
+from verl.utils.fsdp_utils import apply_fsdp2
+from verl.workers.engine.fsdp.transformer_impl import FSDPEngineWithLMHead
+
+
+def _export_worker(rank, world_size, rendezvous, output_dir, dtype, offload):
+    get_torch_device().set_device(rank)
+    backend = f"cpu:gloo,{get_device_name()}:{get_nccl_backend()}"
+    dist.init_process_group(backend, init_method=f"file://{rendezvous}", rank=rank, world_size=world_size)
+    device = torch.device(get_device_name(), rank)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    config = Qwen2Config(
+        vocab_size=64,
+        hidden_size=32,
+        intermediate_size=64,
+        num_hidden_layers=1,
+        num_attention_heads=4,
+        num_key_value_heads=2,
+        tie_word_embeddings=True,
+    )
+    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_config(config, attn_implementation="eager").to(device)
+    model = get_peft_model(model, LoraConfig(r=2, lora_alpha=4, target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"]))
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
+            if "lora_B" in name:
+                parameter.uniform_(-0.1, 0.1)
+    reference = copy.deepcopy(model).merge_and_unload().eval()
+    original = {name: value.detach().clone() for name, value in model.state_dict().items()}
+    kwargs = dict(
+        mesh=init_device_mesh(get_device_name(), (world_size,)),
+        mp_policy=MixedPrecisionPolicy(param_dtype=dtype, reduce_dtype=torch.float32),
+    )
+    if offload:
+        kwargs["offload_policy"] = CPUOffloadPolicy()
+    apply_fsdp2(model, kwargs, {})
+
+    # Exercise the engine's real export callback with a locally constructed model.
+    engine = object.__new__(FSDPEngineWithLMHead)
+    engine.module = model
+    engine._is_lora = True
+    engine._is_offload_param = False
+    manager = FSDPCheckpointManager(
+        model=model,
+        checkpoint_config={"save_contents": ["hf_model"], "load_contents": ["model"]},
+        per_tensor_param_fn=engine._get_hf_export_per_tensor_param,
+        hf_export_dtype=dtype,
+    )
+    manager.save_checkpoint(output_dir, global_step=1)
+
+    for name, value in model.state_dict().items():
+        actual = value.full_tensor().to(device) if hasattr(value, "full_tensor") else value
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, original[name], rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+    if rank == 0:
+        hf_path = f"{output_dir}/huggingface"
+        with open(f"{hf_path}/model.safetensors.index.json") as handle:
+            index = json.load(handle)
+        saved = {}
+        for shard in set(index["weight_map"].values()):
+            saved.update(load_file(f"{hf_path}/{shard}"))
+        assert set(saved) == set(reference.state_dict()) - {"lm_head.weight"}
+        for name, value in saved.items():
+            expected = reference.state_dict()[name].to(dtype).cpu()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(value, expected, msg=lambda message, name=name: f"{name}: {message}")
+        loaded = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(hf_path, dtype=dtype, attn_implementation="eager").to(device)
+        inputs = torch.arange(16, device=device).view(1, -1)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            torch.testing.assert_close(loaded(inputs).logits, copy.deepcopy(reference).to(dtype)(inputs).logits)
+
+    # Rollout keeps its BF16 contract, including after an HF export.
+    rollout_weights = dict(engine._merged_lora_per_tensor_param())
+    for name, value in rollout_weights.items():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            value, reference.state_dict()[name].to(torch.bfloat16), msg=lambda message, name=name: f"{name}: {message}"
+        )
+    dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.float16, torch.bfloat16], ids=["fp32", "fp16", "bf16"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("offload", [False, True])
+def test_fsdp2_lora_hf_export(tmp_path, dtype, offload):
+    mp.spawn(
+        _export_worker,
+        args=(2, str(tmp_path / "rendezvous"), str(tmp_path / "checkpoint"), dtype, offload),
+        nprocs=2,
+        join=True,
+    )
